dimensions.label: Mind
dimensions.subtitle: Task-Level Reasoning
dimensions.purpose: Maintain task state, interpret instructions and observations, infer goals and prerequisites, and choose the sequence of operations.

dimensions.label: Act
dimensions.subtitle: Constraint-Aware Execution
dimensions.purpose: Realize intended operations under timing, geometric, contact, and stability constraints.

dimensions.label: Mind2Act
dimensions.subtitle: Reasoning–Acting Coordination
dimensions.purpose: Let task intent guide valid actions, and actual execution outcomes update remaining goals, action timing, and phase progression.

P.name: Order-Based Meal Assembly
P.mechanism: Short-lived orders; occluded container contents; maintain cumulative demand separately from actual delivered quantities; new orders may arrive during execution.
P.constraints: No priority or mandatory switching rule.

PR3.name: Marker Line Tracing
PR3.mechanism: Continuous physical pen contact along a reference centerline. Ink derives from real contact; hovering makes no ink.

CP05.name: Keyboard Sequence Reproduction
CP05.mechanism: Remember key identity, order, and repeats; reproduce with effective strikes and releases; complete setup and tool return.

hard.preparation: Remove cloth and set volume MIN to MAX

CP05.constraints: Demonstration uses 2 seconds per event; reproduction is not scored on beat matching. Synchronous tool pickup and return do not mean simultaneous key strikes.

typography.body_computed: Inter, Aptos, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
typography.guidance: Use clean sans-serif display and editorial hierarchy for the film; reserve pixel typography/edges for the moon brand and small instrumentation.

hero_demo.treatment: Full-bleed keyboard footage. Navy gradient at bottom, moon identity lower left, memory cards off the action area. A highlighted key snapshot flies into the memory rail; during reproduction cards progress on registered trigger/release.
hero_demo.matching_caution: Website uses an October-09 replay. September-23 local videos have a different provenance; do not transplant timed note events without matching source.
hero_demo.motion_chart: Website includes recorded world-coordinate tool-tip heights. Use only as historical audit, not as new policy observations; do not invent such data for another video.
